gameDescriptionHtml: Youtubers Life is the ultimate life simulation/tycoon videogame in which you can become the world’s greatest content creator in history by editing videos, expanding the number of fans and turning yourself into a wealthy fellow. Create your character and start making your first broadcasts in the cosy room at your parents’ where you have grown up since you were little. Keep an eye on daily tasks and socialise yourself to increase your popularity while you have to deal with fans, friends, family and time management!
